title: End-to-End Error Propagation Analysis
analysis_type: Descriptive/exploratory analysis of frozen evaluation outputs
protocol_notes: No model training or retraining performed.
No segmentation, geometry, EF, or classification thresholds modified.
All analyses use the frozen 50-patient evaluation outputs.
Associations are exploratory and do not establish causation.
Multiple exploratory statistical comparisons were performed; individual p-values are not treated as confirmatory evidence.
Absolute EF error components are not assumed to be additive.
